model.description: Groq model id (e.g. 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', 'llama-3.1-8b-instant'). Free text accepted for new models; the model picker lists the live catalog.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level. Only applies to models that support reasoning; 'disabled' turns it off.

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: Force JSON-array output via a json_schema response_format. Only enable for models that honor response_format; leave off otherwise.
